data.long_description:
Experience serene waterfront living in this spacious 1 bed apartment in Azizi Mirage 1, located in the vibrant community of Dubai Studio City. This well-designed unit spans 608 sqft, offering a comfortable layout with plenty of natural light and a stunning full lagoon view that creates a peaceful living environment.

The apartment comes semi furnished, making it ideal for tenants looking for convenience while still having the flexibility to personalize their space. It is vacant and ready to move in, perfect for immediate occupancy.

Spacious 1 bed Layout
Full Lagoon View
Semi Furnished
608 Sqft

Modern Bathroom
Bright Living Space

Located in a prime area, the property offers easy access to Motor City, Dubai Sports City, and major highways, ensuring seamless connectivity across Dubai.
